meta.name: accli
meta.description: This skill should be used when interacting with Apple Calendar on macOS. Use it for listing calendars, viewing events, creating/updating/deleting calendar events, and checking availability/free-busy times. Triggers on requests like "check my calendar", "schedule a meeting", "what's on my schedule", "am I free tomorrow", or any calendar-related operations.

copy.tagline: 管理苹果日历上的日程和事件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常用苹果日历管理日程
copy.tagline_en: Manage events and schedules on Apple Calendar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often manage your schedule with Apple Calendar

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以读取你的 macOS 日历、列出日历、查看事件、创建/更新/删除事件，以及检查空闲/忙碌时间。
howto.when: 当你要求查看日历、安排会议、询问日程或检查空闲时间时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下明天上午的日程
在“工作”日历上创建一个明天下午3点的会议
say.note: 创建事件前会先检查空闲时间

say.text: 把今天下午2点的会议改到3点

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read your macOS calendar, list calendars, view events, create/update/delete events, and check free/busy times.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to check your calendar, schedule a meeting, view your schedule, or check availability.

say_en.text: Check my schedule for tomorrow morning.
Create a meeting at 3 PM tomorrow on my Work calendar.
Reschedule today's 2 PM meeting to 3 PM.
